title: Zebra fixes focus on reliable synchronization
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
02
Zebra fixes focus on reliable synchronization
Engineering period: Aug 24-Sep 6 · Published Sep 9
ZCASH FOUNDATION
ZEBRA + ZALLET
01
Chain-tip recovery
Retries for blocks awaiting a parent address the recurring near-tip sync restart loop.
02
Operator efficiency
Bounded lookups, lower memory use and state-snapshot guidance improve node
operation.
03
Shared wallet work
ZF contributed cleaner retry and error handling to ZODL’s Zallet wallet.
04
Next networking layer
QUIC and chunked synchronization remain experimental and disabled by default.

title: Crosslink gains community analytics
text:
OPENZCASH

ORGANIZATIONS

Crosslink gains community analytics
September feature-network updates · No mainnet activation announced
SHIELDED LABS
CROSSLINK + PROTOCOL RESEARCH
01
Historical staking data
Sep 6: a community indexer exposes mining, staking and finalizer history for analysis.
02
Wallet integration feedback
Sep 7-8: Nozy’s developer reported feature-network staking lifecycle tests and
integration gaps.
03
Protocol discussion

PROJECT TACHYON
PROTOCOL + PROVING RESEARCH
01
Protocol state
Tachyon changes cover epoch-state grouping and summaries of consecutive stamps.

title: Zakura improves mining and verification
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
BUILD & WALLETS
05
Zakura improves mining and verification
Full-node software
 1.4.0
SEP 10 / STABLE
01
Mining work
Prepared candidates can be reused, with tighter admission and recovery handling.
02
Faster catch-up
Header-root repair and checkpoint handling reduce unnecessary waits.
03
Shared components
Includes Zakura Common 1.2.0 and raises the minimum supported Rust version.
04
Operator deadline
This release halts at block 3,504,731, estimated around October 3. Plan the next
upgrade.

text:

PROJECT
REPORTED PROGRESS

Hito
Milestone 3: offline signing and network integration on physical
hardware.
Mainnet flow reported; broader testing, UI work and

Unified wallet support progressing on Pro2.
Ironwood on-device signing still pending; launch

title: New products broaden ZEC use cases
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ECOSYSTEM
09
New products broaden ZEC use cases
Announcements published September 1-10 · Developer-reported status
01
0xramp
Sep 1: v1.0.0 announced with fiat-first quotes
and receipts. ZEC delivery uses transparent
addresses.
02
red·bridge
Sep 9: website and beta-tester signup
launched. A product launch is not implied.
03
ZecGuard
Sep 4-9: paid access for Telegram and Discord
announced, using shielded ZEC payments.
04
Zpay.cash
Sep 9: ZEC-to-Venmo service introduced.
Additional checkout integrations remain
unfinished.
05
Konclave
Sep 7 report covers Aug 27-Sep 7: v0.3.0,
recovery and privacy work; open limitations
remain.
06
Ballast
Sep 10: desktop trading app introduced before
open beta. Transparent bridge hop disclosed;
no independent audit yet.
